releaseNotes: Full sync from test repo: all features up to v1.0.30
Multi-step Add Material wizard (Invoice → Selection → Form → Session List → Finish)
Multi-step Dispatch Material wizard with multi-item session (accumulate then 'Finish & Dispatch All')
Toast notification system (top-right overlay, slide+fade animation)
Pagination in inventory view (20 per page, prev/next controls)
Check for Updates in sidebar version label (app-level action)
Consistent border radius (12px) across all cards
Interactive pie charts with distinct colors in Dashboard & Reports
Version label in sidebar shows update availability
